setup.title: Set up Kafka monitoring
setup.subtitle: The Kafka views need spans from both sides of a topic plus the Kafka receiver metrics.

producers.title: Instrument producers
producers.description: Send producer spans with messaging.system = kafka and the destination and partition attributes.

consumers.title: Instrument consumers
consumers.description: Send consumer spans with the consumer group, partition, client ID and message size of each message.

kafka.title: Collect Kafka metrics
kafka.description: Enable the Kafka metrics receiver in your collector for consumer lag and fetch latency.

views.title: Kafka views
views.subtitle: Each view opens the Kafka detail with its own filters.

consumerLag.title: Consumer lag
consumerLag.description: How far each consumer group is behind the latest offset, per topic and partition.

partitionLatency.title: Partition latency
partitionLatency.description: p99, error rate and throughput per topic partition, for producers and consumer groups.

producerLatency.title: Producer latency
producerLatency.description: Latency, error rate and throughput per producer or consumer service and topic.

dropRate.title: Drop rate
dropRate.description: Share of messages whose producer-to-consumer time breaches an evaluation interval.

metricPage.title: Metrics
metricPage.description: Broker, producer, consumer, JVM and partition metrics from the Kafka receivers.
